messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: DT query
parts:
Okay, we have made a change in DT so that the usage of
DT::renderDataTable() is almost the same as shiny::renderDataTable()
now, i.e. DT::renderDataTable(data) should just work. The previously
documented usage DT::renderDataTable(datatable(data)) still works,
though. Please install the latest version from
https://github.com/rstudio/DT and test it if you are interested.
Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui
